notes.text: For a custom ActiveCampaign Site Tracking installation, check the Track by Default setting. The vendor documents setting it to false and calling allowTracking after the visitor agrees. Merely replacing the tracking snippet or displaying a banner does not change that default. Arrange this connection in the actual installation and test refusal as well as acceptance.

Acuity can prefill contact and intake fields from URL parameters, including parameters passed through the page hosting an embedded scheduler. Review prefilled links before publishing or sharing them, and avoid including private client details in a public link. A field marked Internal Use Only can still be set through these parameters.

Adobe Fonts’ web licence uses Adobe’s embed code and hosted delivery. It does not include permission to copy the font files to your own server. If local hosting is needed, obtain a suitable licence from the font foundry or an authorised reseller. For a client site, use the client’s own Creative Cloud subscription for the web project.

Amplitude can create cookies when its browser SDK initializes, even with event tracking opted out. If your setup must avoid those cookies until the visitor chooses, defer initialization. Switching to local storage changes persistence; it is not a switch that stops data collection.

Apple Music player behavior differs for visitors who are signed in. When a signed-in visitor interacts with the player, Apple collects the same information as in the Music app along with the embedding page’s domain. A signed-out preview should not be treated as representative of signed-in playback.

Playing an episode in Apple’s embedded player streams it from the podcast’s hosting provider. Those plays are not included in Apple Podcasts Connect Analytics; check the hosting provider’s reporting when assessing listening on your website.

Apple says player interaction data may be associated with a visitor who is or was signed in to an Apple media service in that browser. The embedded player should not be described as anonymous for every visitor.

When using Awin consent signals, set AWIN.Tracking.AdvertiserConsent before the MasterTag loads and pass later changes through its consent API. Missing or invalid values are treated as consent having been obtained. Awin documents exceptions for cashback and loyalty tracking, and says partner plugins are outside this signal mechanism. Do not treat the signal as a switch that blocks every Awin request or as a decision about your legal obligations.

Bookingkit support can disable the booking widget’s performance and personalization cookies, such as those associated with Google Analytics, Tripadvisor and YouTube. Bookingkit distinguishes these from technical and payment cookies, which it says cannot be switched off. Request the change for the widget; settings for Bookingkit’s own website are separate.

For Bunny Player embeds, set rememberPosition=false to stop saving playback progress, or rememberSettings=false to disable both saved preferences and saved progress. Bunny documents the latter as disabling local-storage reads and writes for these features. These settings change browser persistence; the player still requests video and may send technical performance telemetry to Bunny.

Calendly’s Hide Cookie Banner option only hides the banner in an embed; Calendly says cookies are still used. If you use this option, configure and check how your website manages the visitor’s preferences and when it loads Calendly. Do not treat hiding the banner as disabling tracking or as an automatic connection to your website’s consent tool.

The WordPress plugin’s Set cookies option changes where anti-spam data is kept. Off still uses browser local storage. The separate alternative mechanism uses the site database through AJAX or the WordPress REST API. Auto switches between On and Off according to detected caching. Check the selected mode before describing the integration as storing nothing in the browser.

Check that the form integration validates each Turnstile token on the server with Siteverify before accepting a submission. Displaying the widget alone does not protect the form. Tokens expire after five minutes and can be used only once, so forms left open or submitted again need a fresh token.

Pre-clearance is an optional feature for Cloudflare-protected domains. It issues a clearance cookie and requires the correct registered zone, widget hostnames and security challenges. Check whether you enabled this option before describing a Turnstile setup as cookie-free.

Contentsquare’s cookieless tracking mode moves tracking state into local storage and session storage. It does not mean there is no browser storage. Check the project’s collection settings separately when deciding when its tag should run.

Crisp’s Total Privacy mode, under Chatbox Security settings, waits until a visitor opens the chatbox before starting the session and setting its cookies. Review this setting if you do not need a session for every page visitor. Check network requests separately: delaying session creation is different from delaying the chatbox script itself.

Check the widget settings in your Discord server before embedding it. The widget can include an invitation to the selected channel as well as online-member information. Set the invite channel to no invite if you only want to display the widget without offering a join link.

Elfsight says the account owner can ask its support team to disable its visitor view-count cookie for all widgets in that account. This does not disable cookies used by embedded social platforms; its guide identifies Facebook, YouTube and Tumblr as possible additional sources. Review the actual widget type when choosing this account-wide setting.

For Elfsight widgets with a font selector, choose Default (Apply from Website) to inherit your site fonts instead of loading Google Fonts through the widget setting. Check the widget type: Elfsight says its Google Maps app can still load Google Fonts while fetching location data, despite having no font selector.

Replace legacy Eversports widget links and embed code with the new individual widgets or Widget Overview. Eversports ended direct bookings through old widget links after May 31, 2026; those links redirect to the overview instead. Review the overview’s contents and test the destination of your booking links, including links in emails and automations.

Check the photo's visibility before using an embed. Flickr says private photos cannot be displayed outside Flickr. Sharing non-public content by a Guest Pass is a separate option: anyone who receives that link can view the shared content, so avoid putting a private Guest Pass on a public page.

Fullstory’s element-consent API controls capture of designated page elements. It does not block other information sent through identification or user-data API calls. If those calls should wait for a visitor’s choice, arrange that separately in the site’s integration.

Non-personalized AdSense ads still use cookies for frequency capping and reporting. Limited ads are a separate setting: programmatic limited ads can use cookies and local storage for invalid-traffic detection. Google currently enables limited ads by default; review Brand Safety, Blocking controls, Ad serving if you want to turn them off. These settings do not mean that ad delivery stops exchanging data.

In your GA4 web data stream, review the individual Enhanced measurement options, including site search, outbound clicks and form interactions. These can send events without extra site code. Check the parameters being collected, especially search terms and URLs, and keep personally identifiable information out of Analytics.

Choose the Consent Mode setup deliberately: Google's basic implementation blocks Google tags until consent is granted, while its advanced implementation loads them with consent defaults and can send cookieless measurements when consent is denied. Denied storage consent alone does not mean no data is sent. These are Google tag behaviors; the outcome depends on your site's implementation.

Check which Google Calendar view you are embedding. An ordinary embedded calendar follows its sharing permissions, so use a separate calendar containing only events intended for your audience. Appointment booking pages are always public to anyone with the link and display your account name and profile photo. Review those details before sharing a booking page.

You can download Google Fonts and serve them from your own site. Replace both the external stylesheet and font-file requests so those font loads no longer contact Google. Local copies need your own updates and browser checks. The hosted API does not set or log cookies, but requests still send Google the visitor’s IP address and request headers.

If your integration supports recaptcha.net, use its setting to switch all reCAPTCHA requests to that domain. This avoids the google.com domain and its other possible cookies, but reCAPTCHA still sets its own risk-analysis cookie and exchanges data with Google.

Google changed to a processor role for reCAPTCHA customer data on April 2, 2026. Review older privacy disclosures and badge text against Google’s current instructions: references to its general Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are no longer required for reCAPTCHA. The role change does not remove the risk-analysis cookie or establish that your site’s setup meets every applicable requirement.

If your consent setup runs through Tag Manager, use the Consent Initialization trigger for tags that set or update consent state. It runs before other triggers. Google recommends the Tag Manager consent APIs for templates; queued gtag commands or callbacks may not finish before the next trigger fires.

Review each tag's built-in and additional consent checks. The default Not set option performs no additional checks. Built-in checks may change a tag's behavior instead of blocking it. For tags without built-in consent handling, configure the checks needed for your setup; installing the container alone does not make every tag wait for consent.

In the current WordPress integration, loading the GTranslate widget and translating a page are separate requests. When translation is requested, page text is sent from the visitor’s browser to Google. Paid proxy configurations serve translated pages through GTranslate’s infrastructure. Review the mode you use and which page text is eligible for translation; browser-based translation does not keep that text on the visitor’s device.

Heyflow’s built-in cookie banner is shown only in standalone flows. In an embedded flow, it is not displayed and analytics integrations may fail to load correctly. Review the flow’s tracking integrations and control when the embed loads through your website’s consent setup. Heyflow says external cookie tools cannot currently control individual scripts inside a flow.

Review the chatflow’s Consent to collect chat cookies setting. Prompting before chat prevents visitors from starting a chat without accepting; prompting on exit lets them start, but the conversation ends on navigation if they decline. Choose the timing deliberately and check the separate analytics-banner settings.

Keep private values out of the page URL when embedding Imgur. The current embed script passes the surrounding page URL, including its query string, to the embedded page. Its analytics=false option still includes that URL. Turning off analytics therefore does not mean that the embed stops sending information to Imgur.

If your site identifies logged-in members in Intercom, call Intercom’s shutdown method when they log out. This ends the Messenger session so another person using the same browser does not inherit access to the previous conversation. Connect it to your WordPress logout flow and test switching between accounts.

From Jetpack 16.4, Stats responds automatically to the statistics choice when the WP Consent API plugin is active. Declined visits are not counted, so counts may fall after an update or activation. AMP and Web Stories still count every view. Check these page types separately; this vendor behavior does not establish compatibility with a particular cookie banner.

Review Kit's Advanced email-link tracking settings when connecting a WordPress site. Subscriber IDs enable page-visit tagging and personalized content. The separate hashed-email option lets third parties match link clicks to an email address they already hold. Hashing therefore does not make these visits anonymous; choose these settings separately from campaign UTM tags.

Review Extended ID and First-party ID before enabling them. They can recognize an existing profile again after the ordinary browser identifier expires, using other available identifiers or a server-set identifier. Also check cookie controls separately from email preference pages: those pages control message subscriptions, not website tracking.

Leadfeeder’s cookie consent mode must be enabled in the website tracker settings as well as connected to your banner’s consent event. Without that setting, the script still sets cookies. When configured to wait for cookie consent, the script can still identify visiting companies before consent; it loses recognition of returning visitors across sessions. This setting does not stop all tracking requests.

Choose your LiveChat storage region when creating the subscription. Text says existing subscriptions cannot currently be relocated to another region. If you need a particular region, confirm the account’s setup before putting the chat on your site.

Check who can view a Loom video before embedding it on a public page. Loom's public-embedding guide uses anyone-with-the-link access. Hiding the share button, title or owner in the player changes its appearance; those settings do not restrict who can open the video link. Use the video's sharing permissions to control access.

If regional storage matters to your Loom setup, choose it while creating a new workspace in Atlassian Administration. Loom currently says an existing workspace cannot be moved to a regional workspace and its video content cannot be transferred into one. Check eligibility before planning a migration; selecting a region for a new workspace does not move your existing videos.

Mailchimp for WooCommerce provides a developer filter to disable its cookies. The vendor warns that disabling them removes abandoned-cart automations for guest shoppers, while logged-in shoppers can still be handled. Review that tradeoff and the logged-in flow; disabling guest cookies does not switch off every transfer from WooCommerce to Mailchimp.

Use a dedicated public access token for the website with only the permissions its map needs. Add URL restrictions for the sites allowed to use it; the default public token cannot have these restrictions. A token in a page is visible to visitors, so never place a token with secret permissions in frontend settings or code.

Review the optional Ask Matomo setting before using it with sensitive reports. When enabled and used, it sends prompts and relevant Matomo data to Amazon Bedrock. Matomo says the current model uses global cross-region inference; turning on the feature can therefore change the processing scope of an otherwise EU-hosted instance.

Choose Matomo’s consent API to match the behavior you intend. Calling requireConsent before tracking prevents tracking requests until consent is given. Calling requireCookieConsent still allows tracking requests while withholding cookies. These are different vendor settings, not interchangeable ways to stop analytics.

Configure UET consent signals explicitly. Microsoft documents UET Consent Mode and TCF as alternatives and says not to use both at once. In its basic mode, the tag waits for consent; in advanced mode it can load with consent denied and still send data for aggregate modeling. Check the chosen setup with UET Tag Helper; a Google tag consent setting alone does not establish that a custom UET installation receives it.

Review Booking page access control before embedding a shared booking page. Requiring a Microsoft 365 account from your organization restricts access to your organization’s accounts, so it prevents external customers from booking. Disabling search-engine indexing is a separate setting; it does not authenticate visitors who have the page link.

Clarity can still report visits without cookie consent. In that mode, each pageview becomes a separate session, returning visitors appear as new visitors, and multi-page funnels lose continuity. Do not use the absence of Clarity cookies as proof that no visit data is being collected.

Mux Player has separate controls for cookies and analytics. disable-cookies prevents Mux Data cookies but does not disable Mux Data tracking; use disable-tracking for that. Player preferences are separate: no-volume-pref and no-muted-pref disable saving those preferences in local storage. Check the player settings exposed by your integration before assuming that a cookie setting disables all storage or analytics.

Check the reporting instructions supplied with your licensed web-font kit before treating self-hosting as removing all external requests. Monotype’s self-hosting kits can include a tracking stylesheet for usage reporting. Its font-tracking policy says this reporting does not use cookies, but requests still reach its service provider.

OneSignal separates permission to collect user data from permission to receive push messages. Enable its data-consent requirement before SDK initialization if collection should wait for a choice. Revoking that consent does not unsubscribe an existing push subscription: OneSignal says to call the SDK optOut method before revoking consent if notifications should also stop.

The ChatGPT Ads Measurement Pixel defaults to measurement consent being granted unless you set it to false or it finds a stored denial. If your setup should wait for a visitor choice, send the pixel consent=false command before initialization and update it after that choice. When denied, the pixel does not send measurement-event pings; granting it later permits future events and does not replay blocked events.

OpenStreetMap’s standard tile servers are a shared service, not an unlimited map-hosting plan. Keep visible attribution, respect their caching rules, and do not bulk-download or prefetch tiles for offline use. Check the tile usage policy before using a WordPress map plugin’s preload or offline feature; another tile provider has its own terms.

With Paddle Billing, Retain integrates through Paddle.js without a separate script installation. On logged-in pages, pass the signed-in customer’s Paddle customer ID in pwCustomer; your WordPress user ID or a subscription ID will not work. Public-facing pages use standard initialization. Follow the separate integration instructions if you use another billing platform.

Test the booking journey on both desktop and mobile. Phorest’s floating booking widget opens the booking page in a new tab on mobile, and its automatic opening option also leads to a separate tab or window there. Phorest also supports a direct booking link behind your own button if you do not need the floating widget.

Review automatic enhanced match before enabling it. Pinterest says it can collect and hash customer information found in form fields, with the collected fields controlled by the advertiser settings. This adds information to ad matching beyond page and event data. Check the configured fields and outgoing tag requests rather than assuming the tag sends only a page view.

Pipedrive says its Chatbot and Web Forms do not detect or respond to consent-banner signals or visitor opt-out preferences. If your setup should wait for permission, configure and test the loading of those embeds explicitly. The separate Web Visitors product has different consent settings; do not assume those settings control Chatbot or Web Forms.

When checking Plausible’s WordPress installation, remember that its official plugin excludes visits from logged-in administrators by default. Test while logged out, or review the plugin’s user-role tracking settings before treating missing visits as a broken installation.

Place Podigee’s standard script embed in the page body. Loading it in the page head is not supported. Copy the complete code from your podcast or episode, and check the published page because available functions vary with the player configuration.

Choose the cookie event to match when a popup should stop appearing. Popup Maker defaults to setting its cookie when the visitor closes the popup, so simply seeing it does not prevent another display. Use the open event if seeing it should be enough, or the form-submission event for a supported form. Check this alongside the popup trigger and configured duration.

PostHog stores analytics state and consent decisions separately. Sharing an analytics cookie across subdomains does not share the consent choice by default. If your setup needs one choice across subdomains, configure PostHog’s consent storage on each subdomain and test the choice separately from visitor identification.

A Reddit embed is not a fixed copy of the original post or comment. Reddit says edits or deletion cause the embed to show a change notice with a link to the current version. Recheck embedded material that your page relies on, especially if it supports instructions or a quotation.

Rybbit’s optional identify feature links activity to a persistent user identity, including recent activity before sign-in. Its clearUserId method clears the browser’s stored user ID for future events, but does not remove database aliases or previously attributed events. Review this behavior before adding identification to a sign-in flow.

Review each enabled Segment destination separately. Device-mode destinations load their own SDKs, whose cookie behavior Segment does not control. An EU Segment workspace also does not guarantee that every connected destination processes data in the EU.

Senja lets you export a testimonial widget as an image or share its hosted link, as alternatives to embedding it. An image export does not update when testimonials change, so export it again when you need fresh content. An embedded widget updates automatically when you change its testimonials or design.

To change a Buy Button’s appearance after embedding it, create a new button in the Shopify Buy Button channel and replace the old embed code on your WordPress page. Choose whether checkout opens in a new window or the same tab, then test the published page.

Smartlook’s cookies setting controls where it stores metadata. Setting cookies to false still uses local storage; it does not turn off the recorder. Check the recording setup separately when deciding when Smartlook should run.

Review Smartsupp’s Security and privacy settings before enabling the chat. Smartsupp says new accounts have IP-address storage and some other sensitive-data storage turned off by default, but these settings can be changed. Also review any enabled analytics and targeted-message features separately from basic support chat.

Preserve the encrypted-media permission in Spotify’s generated embed code. Removing it can limit playback to previews. If only previews play, also check whether the visitor’s browser supports Spotify playback.

Review Strava's sharing settings for the type of embed you use. An individual activity needs both the profile and activity set to Everyone, and an embedded route must be public. Strava says an embedded profile feed can include activities set to Followers as well as Everyone, while a club feed only includes Everyone activities. Check the embedded feed before publishing it.

If an older Strava activity embed stops displaying, obtain a fresh embed code from that activity's share menu. Strava says the older activity embed format is no longer supported. Replace each affected embed rather than assuming the activity was deleted or changing its privacy settings to fix a format problem.

Review which pages load Stripe.js in your payment integration. Stripe recommends loading it throughout the shopping experience, beyond checkout, to improve fraud detection. This collects device and activity signals on those pages, so account for that broader collection when deciding where to load it.

Stripe allows disabling advanced fraud detection on your own site, but warns that this increases fraud risk. It does not stop collection on Stripe-hosted pages, events from Stripe-managed checkout fields, or basic device information used in 3D Secure 2 authentication. Treat this as a limited setting, not a switch that stops all Stripe data collection.

Review Email notifications in your form settings before enabling Self email notifications: their default body includes all non-empty answers. Tally offers paid customization of the body and individual fields. Check the recipients and any PDF attachment setting so that notification emails contain only the response details you intend to share.

tawk.to offers a built-in consent form that delays its cookies and local storage until the visitor submits it. Its settings distinguish European visitors from visitors in supported US two-party-consent states, so check each audience you intend to cover. The form is a vendor feature; its presence does not establish that your site-wide consent setup controls the widget.

For a new integration, use TikTok's current Embed Player instructions. TikTok is retiring the older Embed Videos integration and says existing integrations will migrate automatically. In the new player, setting rel to 0 switches related videos to the current author's videos; it does not remove related videos altogether.

Turning off first-party cookies in TikTok Pixel settings stops it from setting new first-party cookies. TikTok says existing first-party cookies continue operating until they expire, and third-party cookies are a separate part of the pixel. Review the complete pixel setup when changing this setting; switching it off does not by itself stop all measurement.

Trusted Shops documents a consent integration that prevents automatic order-data transfer until consent, while still displaying the Trustcard. Customers can initiate a transfer by interacting with that card to request buyer protection or a review invitation. The integration requires adapting the vendor’s consent signaller and having Trusted Shops enable the feature. It is distinct from blocking the entire widget.

In the form settings, enable Cookie consent, save and publish the form. Typeform says this blocks tracking cookies, including those used by connected integrations, until the respondent accepts. Review the form’s connected integrations as well; this setting is not a promise that loading the form sends no data.

If your integration uses the Unsplash API, its guidelines require displaying images through the image URLs returned in photo.urls. Replacing these with locally hosted copies is not the default API workflow. Unsplash directs integrations that need their own image hosting to its API team to discuss an alternative. Check whether your WordPress integration uses the API before choosing how to host its images.

Usermaven’s strict mode still collects visit data and uses the IP address and user agent to distinguish visitors. Its identity API can link that activity to a known user. Review identification calls as well as the tracking mode before describing your setup as anonymous.

If you pin a UserWay widget version so you can test it before rollout, plan to update that pin. UserWay documents a dashboard endpoint that supplies the current fixed script and optional integrity hash, and asks owners using fixed versions to update quarterly because old versions are not supported indefinitely. Include those updates in your site maintenance.

Place a VG WORT counter only on the page containing the eligible text. Related pages containing only images, advertising or other ineligible material must not use that counter. Incorrect placement can cause VG WORT to deactivate the counter and reject the report.
Enable Vimeo’s dnt player parameter to disable session tracking and analytics for that embed. The parameter is off by default.

Vimeo’s dnt option still allows essential security cookies. Previously stored Vimeo cookies may still be sent with requests, so enabling the option does not make the player free of cookies or data exchange.

Review Wistia’s account-wide Privacy Mode before embedding videos. It disables session and cookie tracking and anonymizes IP addresses while retaining aggregate viewing data, so individual viewer histories and attribution will be reduced.

Wistia’s Privacy Mode is not a promise of no browser storage: non-tracking cookies and local storage can remain. Live events using a Wistia registration form can still collect identifiable event data while Privacy Mode is enabled.

Turn order attribution on or off under the Features section of WooCommerce’s advanced settings. WooCommerce provides a WP Consent API integration; version 11.2.2 uses its marketing consent signal when that API is active. Check the consent connection on your site before relying on it. Turning attribution off does not remove information already attached to past orders.

To replace an image already cached by Site Accelerator, upload it under a new filename and update the page’s image reference. Query-string cache busters do not refresh it. Jetpack does not offer an automatic whole-site image purge; removing selected cached images requires contacting its support team.

When placing several XING share buttons on a page, add the button setup for each location but load the XING share library only once. XING’s documentation separates those two parts of its generated embed code.

Review tracking integrations on the booking page before embedding it. YouCanBookMe says its standard embed omits its cookie banner, but adding tracking integrations such as Google Analytics makes the banner appear. To remove that tracking-related banner, disable those integrations on the embedded booking page. The absence of a banner does not mean the booking service uses no cookies.

For privacy-enhanced embeds, change the player URL's domain from www.youtube.com to www.youtube-nocookie.com. YouTube says views in this mode do not personalize the viewer's YouTube experience or advertising outside your site; ads shown in the player are non-personalized.

Do not interpret the nocookie name as no data exchange or automatic legal compliance. YouTube documents basic data sharing when its embedded player loads and further sharing on playback. Its privacy-enhanced option limits personalization; the embedded player remains subject to YouTube's terms and developer policies.

Zoho Campaigns offers a No JavaScript signup-form option. It omits CAPTCHA, tracking code, multiple-list subscription and the date field. Review those tradeoffs before choosing it, especially your spam-protection needs. The form still sends signup details to Zoho; removing the script does not mean that no data is exchanged.

When copying an iframe embed, choose between Basic iframe and Advanced iframe with Referrer Tracking. The advanced option captures the complete source-page URL, including its path and query parameters; the basic option records the base URL. Use the basic option when you do not need detailed referral data, and avoid putting sensitive information in page URLs.

The Cookies Policy banner settings offer a notice-only mode and a mode that lets visitors opt out. Choose the intended behavior explicitly. Zoho’s guide describes tracking decisions applying from the next visit; do not assume that enabling the banner blocks all tracking on the first visit. Check first visits, return visits and withdrawal in your site’s actual setup.
